question: Why is there a drop in Tidesend on the week of 2026-06-15?

Based on the data provided, the drop in Tidesend on the week of 2026-06-15 is explained by the staff note from that week:

**2026-06-15 D05 Tidesend (South), N. Farrow: Staff walkout over rota changes. Depot shut Monday to Thursday, reopened Friday with a skeleton crew. No new hires could be issued while shut.**

This caused on-rent days to fall from 2,008 (week of 2026-06-08) to 781 (week of 2026-06-15) — a drop of 1,227 on-rent days. The depot was effectively closed for four days of that week, and even when it reopened on Friday, it was only with a skeleton crew.
